title: Order of Operations (BODMAS)
seo_title: BODMAS – JSS 1 Mathematics Worksheets with Answers (NERDC)
standard_text: Use BODMAS to simplify expressions with brackets, powers, division, multiplication, addition and subtraction. (summary of the NERDC JSS 1 Mathematics curriculum)
meta_desc: Free JSS 1 maths worksheets on BODMAS: multiplication and division before addition and subtraction, brackets, powers, negative numbers and placing brackets. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: B O D M A S
key_sub: Same rank: work left to right.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Brackets first, then Of (powers), then Division and Multiplication from left to right, then Addition and Subtraction from left to right.
  • −3² means −(3²) = −9, but (−3)² = 9.

Examples

Example

20 − 3 × 2²

2² = 4

3 × 4 = 12

20 − 12

Answer: 8

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Working left to right only× and ÷ come before + and −.
Squaring before the bracketsBrackets come first.
Doing + before −+ and − have equal rank: left to right.
